Gautam Adani Advocates for Higher Standards in India's Development

Industrialist Gautam Adani spoke at the CareEdge Summit, advocating for India to adopt broader perspectives rather than lower its standards in its development journey. He emphasized India's vision for 'Viksit Bharat' and its infrastructure transformation. Adani's remarks suggest a focus on maintaining quality and ambition as the nation progresses.
